subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted gateway disconnects land now with the existing timeout-style fresh-session embedded fallback, or should this PR pause and implement reattach-first recovery before merge?
rationale: Both paths are technically plausible: this PR fixes the same-session transcript collision, while the related open issue argues for avoiding the second execution/delivery entirely through reattach-first behavior.

options.title: Merge focused fresh-session fix
options.body: Accept the possible second execution/delivery boundary for this rare disconnect path and track reattach-first recovery separately in the related issue.

options.title: Extend to reattach-first
options.body: Require this PR to wait on `agent.wait`/transcript recovery before local re-run, reducing duplicate side effects at the cost of a larger behavior change.

options.title: Pause until product direction
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want any accepted-disconnect fallback change without a broader recovery design.

recommendation.title: Merge focused fresh-session fix
recommendation.body: Accept the possible second execution/delivery boundary for this rare disconnect path and track reattach-first recovery separately in the related issue.
